source.criterion: "That is done when we completely build the prompt" (founder, 2026-10-30)

reading: One record per numbered section of the directive's first copy (sections 1-77), with the source's exact heading.
An ask is a testable obligation the section states, with a faithful paraphrase and a short verbatim excerpt. Exhortations no test can observe (for example 'Think deeply') are not asks.

required_tier is what the section's own words ask for: UNIT_VERIFIED for a record, rule or validator; SANDBOX_VERIFIED for behaviour of canonical code with a real ledger and Gate; BODY_VERIFIED for behaviour of the persistent running Body; FOUNDER_ACCEPTED for the founder's own use, key or acceptance; AUTHORIZED_LIVE for a live effect under his grant; EXTERNALLY_VERIFIED and COMMERCIAL_OUTCOME_VERIFIED for what outside parties or markets must confirm.

tier is computed, never declared: the least-verified of the ask's mission requirements, contract functions and own test nodes (acceptance/directive.py). Without a run it is the ceiling that evidence could establish if every cited test passed.
An ask is met only at or above its required tier and covered. A section is DONE only when every ask is met.

Blockers: FOUNDER_ONLY needs Alfonso (his key, device, decision or use); EXTERNAL needs the outside world (people, money, hardware, providers, access); BUILDABLE_NOT_BUILT can be built in this repository now (unit names the gap-map unit when one exists); PRINCIPLE is a standing rule no build completes, guarded by named tests or UNGUARDED.

The prompt is completely built (INTENT-20261030-BUILD-BEFORE-DEVICE-RUN) only when no ask is BUILDABLE_NOT_BUILT or an UNGUARDED PRINCIPLE. Every section DONE additionally needs the founder and external records no test produces.
This map grants, attaches and activates nothing.
